specificSetting: ethical debate about visible green behaviour and hidden systems of consumption

tasks.purpose: synthesise positions, evaluate causal claims and develop a layered account of responsibility
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Source texts are original, no reused phrasing from existing tests. Forbidden concepts (low-waste event, reusable containers, school event) avoided.

tasks.scenario: Review of a public campaign that turns environmental responsibility into spectacle

tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Campaign 'The Green Pledge' is invented; no overlap with existing test reviews. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Report on hidden resource costs in a major institution
tasks.purpose: identify blind spots, evaluate governance and recommend disclosure
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Scenario is a university sustainability audit; no overlap with existing reports. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Article considering whether environmental consistency is an impossible moral demand
tasks.purpose: analyse the demand without dismissing responsibility
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Question is original; no reuse of article frames from existing tests. Forbidden concepts avoided.
